device: single WSL/Linux host, headless Chromium, eight independent browser contexts

wasm.method: host performance.now around one WASM merge_one; includes WASM boundary; excludes setup, decoding, protocol history, rendering and network

local_render_proxy.method: trusted keydown to second animation-frame callback; upper-bound proxy, not a physical screen measurement

remote_visibility.method: one controller monotonic clock from keyboard command to all seven remote DOMs; includes automation overhead; waits for prior edit before next
